title: One education ladder: a named school with no stated degree is uncertain, not a KO
deviations_from_card: (1) The eduDegreeUnstated band driver is job-aware: _confidence takes job.min_education and widens by 4 only when education_gate returns 'uncertain' (a school-named read against a bachelor/master/phd floor). Against a role whose floor is 'any degree' or none the read is fully measured, so no wider band there; the assumption code is candidate-level as the card says. (2) Commit order: the catalog commit (34d679314, under the lock) landed before the test commit; the doc commit (15f1e9067, under the lock) landed last. (3) pipeline.py exposes _CANDIDATE_EDU_CHOICES and transform.py exposes EDU_FOUNDATION as module aliases so the identity test can import them. (4) The write set shrank: nothing else needed editing. A previous attempt at this slot had left education.py and test_education_ladder.py untracked with nothing committed. This build adopted both files, re-checked them against the card and committed them.
notes: Red-before: at base education.py did not exist, so all 7 acceptance cases failed on import. With only the module present, 7 of 11 test methods were red; the 2 guard cases (high_school still KOs, other KO paths byte-identical) were green by design. Measured on the 120-role seed corpus: a 'university' read is KO'd from 0/120 roles (was 46/120), 'bachelor' from 12/120 (unchanged), 'high_school' from 108/120. Gates whose failures belong to other builders (all exit codes above are for this card's paths): npx tsc was red only on sibling files (candidate-timeline.test.ts, devcase-case-postings / devcase-postings-view / devcase channels+lifecycle route tests) and on untracked kpi-sim/. test:python:gate was red on the skip-register tripwire from the sibling's uncommitted test_interview_eval.py/test_run_gated.py edits. A full `python -m unittest discover` ran 3067 tests: the only 3 failures are in those two sibling files. test:unit ran 10916 tests with 2 fails: python-runner-concurrency (the known Windows issue) and rate-limit-contract interview-prep/scorecard (schedule-interview-prep sibling). test:perf is red on ~28 app/api routes at about 3.1 MB, +1 KB over their ceilings. This card did not cause it: git archive of 11ee55111 plus only this card's 2 TS files moves just 4 measurements by +1 KB (app/page.tsx 9160->9161 of 9194; floor-preview, archetypes and automation/schedule routes, all far under 3117). None of those 4 is a failing route, so no ceiling was raised. matching evals (test:eval:ci) green, ruff ratchet green, codegen --check green, r08 feminine-form and name-neutrality suites green inside the full discover run. schemas.generated.ts and contract-constants.generated.ts were rewritten by codegen with line endings only; they were restored. Closing the loop: the rule removes a KO; every surface that shows education KOs reads ko_filter (winnability loose-gates, recruiter rows, matrix, match meta koReasons), so they follow without edits. The UI localizes driver/assumption codes generically through match.drivers.* and match.assumptions.*, so there is no TS code list to update. loop_open: the UI renders the candidate 'university' slug and the job 'university' slug with the same label enums.education.university ('University'). The files are ProfileEditorFields.tsx, ProfileSummary, DecisionsAnalysisParts and jobsMarkdown.ts. This is the card's runner-up, outside the write set, and is recorded in the doc's Known gaps. Also a stale comment: app/features/library/jobs/jobsMarkdown.ts:183 still says the 'none' special case lives in matching.ko_filter; it now lives in education.education_gate (a comment only, outside the write set).
